The Commission de protection des donnees personnelles is named only as a proposed member of a governance mechanism; no appointment or ruling is stated.

facts.fact: Law no. 2008-12 on personal data protection is cited by SenePlus as classing health information as sensitive data, with no regime specific to the health sector.

The Plan national de developpement sanitaire et social 2023-2028 provides for developing the computerised patient record, unique identification and telemedicine, and Senegal aims to generalise the record by 2034 (SenePlus).
